name: WarStyle Guns
teaser: Adding some new weapons like AK-9, Zastava M70AB2/N, SIG Sauer P226C. A little mods - grips, mags, grenades and etc.
description_html:
Description:

Hello, fellas. This is a product of my 5-6 months working. After 3 years of playing SPT with mods, I noticed that some weapons were never implemented by the authors. Or some modders had some weapons that were not of very high quality. Therefore, I decided to take matters into my own hands, so far I have implemented the AK-9 and Zastava M70AB2, I also changed the sounds, some characteristics, and partially there are proprietary mods that are suitable only for these weapons. There are also 2 new grenades, the first (M26) is an analogue of the M67, but with a shorter fuse. The second grenade (M61) has a blinding effect, concussion, but also has a shock wave. Therefore, I advise you not to fall under this grenade. I hope that even though I have made quite a few weapons for a full-fledged weapon pack so far, I have set the stage for a new weapon pack that can compete with the others.

I advise you to read the documentation, there is information about all ready-made items, plans and credits.

Needed for work

MFAC Shop Module

Installation:

Drop the R41-WarStyle-Guns into your “SPT/user/mods”.
